messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Unable to use input$ in my shiny app within ggplot function
parts:
This is just a ggplot issue actually. 

If you really want a bar plot with just a single bar corresponding to the orders for the selected month then you could try something like this

output$plot<- renderPlot({
    ggplot(data = subset(b, Month == input$monthid), aes(x = Month, y = Orders)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") 
})

That plot won't look very nice but it shouldn't give you any errors so you can work on getting it to look the way you want.
